title: MNIST four-device IBM OM cell-aware exact-bounds quantized HWA transfer
hypothesis: On an untouched repaired IBM OM array, nine-level quantization-aware HWA using exact per-cell affine targets will improve mean programmed test accuracy by at least two percentage points over the matched continuous cell-aware HWA control while retaining at least 90 percent of its own ideal quantized mapped-target accuracy.
motivation: This oracle comparison isolates the benefit and transfer cost of retaining each characterized cell's exact minimum and maximum. It uses the same frozen full-span logical checkpoint, teacher, model, assignment seeds, endpoint seeds, optimizer schedules, checkpoint-selection rule, topology, and cohorts as the RESET-relative study. Unlike that deployable mapper, target construction deliberately consumes hidden cell bounds. Per-cell baselines and spans are left uncompensated so the result measures the cell-aware affine rule itself rather than a common-window or RESET-relative hybrid.

arms.description: Zero optimizer updates from the frozen full-span shadow with nine-level exact-bounds development-array selection.
Ten epochs of clean FP32 BPTT followed by nine-level exact-bounds physical selection.
Ten epochs of compact HWA with continuous exact per-cell affine targets.
Ten epochs of compact endpoint HWA with the nine-level exact-bounds quantizer in every minibatch forward.
Five quantized deployments of the frozen zero-update checkpoint on fresh repaired assignment seed 85001.
Five matched quantized deployments of the selected clean-BPTT checkpoint on assignment seed 85001.
Five continuous exact-bounds deployments of the selected continuous-HWA checkpoint on assignment seed 85001.
Five quantized exact-bounds deployments of the selected QAT checkpoint on assignment seed 85001.

completion_criteria: Before preparation or native execution, verify full-span checkpoint SHA-256 a99995a3e5b321a56bb7e00e29840c3b76f3fee95b8d8c80fdf0fa16e93b3563, derivation receipt SHA-256 d58b0d709312061dc2425d143744f45fdf9de9d5e583a619e7a91325c53059b8, frozen teacher SHA-256 9a961a77628e365b54fdf59304ec7fddf46f1f4834c4c03cecea9c204f837f52, device-model SHA-256 3030e04d6205dc90d0894ac453d2c1c522dffdc004f69b9c6ab7eaf7ef4b8ba3, and every prepared config hash.

The exact-bounds mapper must consume the fixed assigned cell identities and compute L_i=max(0,(logical_min_i+1)/2), H_i=min(1,(logical_max_i+1)/2). It must reconstruct u=(q++-q+--q-++q--)/2 and, in the quantized mode, use n=clamp(round_half_away_from_zero(4u),-4,4). Cell signs are (+,-,-,+), and each target must equal L_i+max(s_i*n,0)*(H_i-L_i)/4. The continuous control replaces n with 4u.

Targets must be quantized before compact endpoint sampling or exact programming. No endpoint is rounded afterward. No target may be clipped, silently narrowed, reassigned, or replaced. All target-support and programming failures remain part of the result.

Every development and held-out deployment must save an immutable exact-bounds codebook artifact containing population and binding provenance, exact and usable per-cell bounds, floors, spans, logical shadows, continuous coordinates, signed codes and indices when quantized, requested targets, target hashes, and baseline/sign-flip diagnostics. The artifact must state that hidden bounds were consumed by target generation.

Development uses the repaired assignment seed 84001, compact endpoint seed 84002, and pulse-resolved selection seed 84003. Training and selection must share the exact population fingerprint, binding order, halves/paired layouts, cell-aware mode, nine-level declaration, gain, and endpoint policy.

The zero-update arm executes no optimizer update. Each other arm completes exactly ten epochs. Checkpoints are selected by the highest mean apparent-forward student accuracy across exactly three programming repeats on assignment 84001; strict improvement preserves the earliest exact tie.

Learning rates are not selected in this study. They must equal the corresponding frozen RESET-relative schedules: clean BPTT [0.1388429752066116,0.00037685950413223146], continuous HWA [0.0017531914893617025,0.000004757787234042554], and quantized QAT [0.004411914893617021,0.000011974808510638298]. Device-forward gains are frozen from assignment 84001 at 3.5481338923357533 continuous and 2.818382931264453 quantized by the immutable cell-aware design receipt, and must be recorded separately from each checkpoint's FP32 shadow gain.

Continuous HWA and quantized QAT use a fresh compact programmed apparent endpoint in every minibatch forward, then restore the clean continuous FP32 shadow before the ideal off-chip optimizer step. Persistent physical state must not accumulate between minibatches.

Assignment seed 85001 must not be sampled, mapped, preflighted, or used for selection until all four development checkpoints and hashes are frozen. Each frozen checkpoint then receives exactly five full-test pulse-resolved deployments with endpoint seeds 85101 through 85105 and fresh exact bounds from assignment 85001.

Every held-out deployment covers all 10,000 test examples and retains apparent and persistent endpoints, acceptance/failure masks, pulse costs, population, exact codebook, source-checkpoint hash, and replayable RNG state. Unsupported or failed targets are reported rather than repaired after inspection.

The study completes only with one valid run for all four development arms and all twenty held-out deployments under artifact-hash verification. No on-chip fine-tuning, Tiki-Taka, LoRA, soft pulse update, extra endpoint seed, or held-out adaptation is eligible evidence.
analysis_plan: Primary: compute the five paired held-out test-accuracy differences between quantized QAT and continuous HWA, their mean, sample standard deviation, and paired bootstrap 95-percent interval. Support requires a mean improvement of at least 0.02 and quantized-QAT mean programmed accuracy at least 90 percent of its mean ideal quantized mapped-target accuracy.

For all four pipelines report clean FP32, ideal cell-aware mapped-target, apparent programmed, and persistent counterfactual accuracy; teacher agreement; KL; raw/calibrated score RMS; shadow and device-forward gains; and prediction flips relative to each pipeline's own ideal mapper.

Report per layer and overall usable floor/span distributions, code histograms, cell-specific zero-code baseline contrast, nominal mapped logical contrast, logical sign flips before programming, apparent/persistent contrast errors, pulse costs, acceptance, budget exhaustion, saturation, clipping, and target support.

Compare zero-update, clean BPTT, continuous HWA, and quantized QAT only after each arm's declared mapper to separate quantization loss, clean retraining, continuous hardware exposure, and quantization-aware exposure.

After the RESET-relative study is complete, compare corresponding arms only if teacher, full-span checkpoint, topology, datasets, schedules, seeds, endpoint model, selection rule, and held-out coverage pass exact provenance parity. Treat the per-cell-versus-RESET comparison as secondary and report the oracle information advantage explicitly.
This study contains no on-chip recovery arm and cannot establish that on-chip fine-tuning is necessary. Preserve the winning apparent/persistent deployment state for a later matched recovery study.
